releases.name: v1.4.0
releases.notes:
## What's new

- Our scripts now share two small helpers. One reads JSON that carries a BOM and writes it atomically (temp file, then rename over the target). The other re-runs a script with a proxy when your system has one. So all four network scripts respect a configured proxy, and a Node runtime that can't use one says so on stderr instead of looking like a network outage.
- Agent discovery is more complete. `scripts/discover-agents.mjs` now reports `mode`, `hidden`, `traits` (worked out from the agent's description, name and mode, with known roles taking priority) and `provenance.fetchedAt`. Built-in names it skips show up under `skippedBuiltins` instead of disappearing, and the workflow now asks you about any entry that might be one of your own agents.
- New flags: `--include-builtin-names`, `--builtin` and `--extra-builtin` for agent discovery, and `--rebuild` for the snapshot refresh.

## Changed

- Refreshes now write the snapshot safely. If the existing snapshot can't be parsed, the script stops with a clear message and leaves your file alone — including your remembered mode and cached scores. It used to quietly start from an empty cache. Use `refresh-snapshot.mjs --rebuild` to discard it on purpose.
- The catalog fetcher and the snapshot summary use the shared helpers too, so what one script writes is what the next one expects.

en.headline: 24 commits across three repos, opencode-go-model-picker released v1.4.0
en.summary: sogeisetsu made **24 own commits** across three repositories plus 35 automated commits by github-actions[bot], all in sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, they initialized a codemap with directory mappings and Atlas, fixed the activity card to use +08 natural-day windows with public-data-only counting, improved AI retry logic for empty-content responses, and added repository count pills to `docs/summary.html`. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker`, they released v1.4.0, fixed scripts from a prior review with atomic snapshot writes, enhanced `discover-agents` to emit full inventory records and report skipped built-ins, and added a version badge derived from `SKILL.md`. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, they corrected outdated knowledge entries on subcommands, skill counts, and Windows ports, and added remote-branch-deletion guidance. They commented on issues #50823 and #56113 in `anomalyco/opencode`, commented on and closed #55785. No PRs or reviews were made.

releaseNotes.summary: Introduced shared helper scripts for BOM-safe JSON reading and atomic snapshot writes with proxy support across network scripts. Enhanced `discover-agents` to emit full inventory records (mode, hidden, traits, provenance.fetchedAt) and report skipped built-ins under `skippedBuiltins`. Added a version badge derived from `SKILL.md` to detect version drift.

zh.headline: 三个仓库提交 24 次，opencode-go-model-picker 发布 v1.4.0
zh.summary: sogeisetsu 在三个仓库提交 **24 次**，另有 35 次由 github-actions[bot] 自动提交（均在 sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu）。在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 中，初始化了 codemap（目录映射 + Atlas），修复活动卡片改用 +08 自然日窗口并只统计公开数据，改进了空响应时的 AI 重试逻辑，并为 `docs/summary.html` 补上仓库条数 pill。在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` 中发布 v1.4.0，修复脚本引入原子快照写入，增强 `discover-agents` 输出完整清单并报告被跳过的内置项，并新增基于 `SKILL.md` 的版本徽章。在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 中修正了过期的子命令列表、skill 数量和 Windows 端口文档，并补充了远程分支删除检查。在 `anomalyco/opencode` 评论了 #50823 和 #56113，并评论后关闭了 #55785。当日无 PR 和代码审查。

releaseNotes.summary: 引入共享辅助脚本（安全读取含 BOM 的 JSON、原子快照写入、代理支持），增强 `discover-agents` 输出完整清单记录（mode、hidden、traits、provenance.fetchedAt）并在 `skippedBuiltins` 中报告被跳过的内置项。新增基于 `SKILL.md` 的版本徽章以检测版本漂移。
